content.title: Amylyx Halts Rare Brain Disorder Drug Program After Disappointing Trial
content.summary: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMLX) on Wednesday decided to discontinue the ORION program of AMX0035 (sodium phenylbutyrate [PB] and taurursodiol [TURSO, also known as ursodoxicoltaurine]) in adults living with progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP).
